payload.title: E4 Short positive memo for read permission (optional, after E1-E2 measured)
payload.description: Only if E1+E2 leave Prospectus as the dominant cost. Memo positive console:read results keyed by (session ref, token hash, account, op), TTL <= 30 s, capped at token expiry, dropped on logout and account select; never memo console:write (worker re-authorizes mutations anyway). Trade-off for Ryan to approve: a revoked membership keeps read access up to the TTL per warm container. Acceptance: 'membership revoked stops access after the TTL; logout drops the entry immediately'.
